# Divider

```tsx
import { Divider } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para separar visualmente conteúdos ou seções, facilitando a organização e a leitura das informações.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
args.orientation === "vertical" ? (
  // Same 240px length as the horizontal one, standing up.
  <div className="flex h-60">
    <Divider {...args} />
  </div>
) : (
  // The Figma Divider is 240px wide.
  <div className="w-60">
    <Divider {...args} />
  </div>
)
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Divider: a 1px line in Border/Secondary that fills its container. Figma only draws it horizontal; `orientation="vertical"` turns the same line upright, stretched to the row's height.

## Rules

- Import `Divider` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
